domainPull: The domain pulls hardest in step 4. A CAVITATING pump moves more water (half) than a LAMINAR one (a quarter), and its discharge 'backflows forward' into the bow-ward compartment instead of going overboard. Both reverse what cavitation and pumping physics would suggest, which is lost efficiency and flow out of the hull. The next strongest pulls are the 'Scuppers', which route excess aft into the next compartment rather than overboard, and the instruction that a compartment 'can sit overfull until next cycle's scuppers', which a physical hull cannot do. Nobody can be shown to have fallen for any of this, because no operator produced working.
